Excellent Stay at Hotel Kundan Palace, New Delhi

I had a wonderful experience staying at Hotel Kundan Palace, New Delhi. From the moment I checked in, the staff behavior was extremely polite, professional, and helpful. Every staff member was cooperative and always ready to assist with a smile, which truly made the stay comfortable and stress-free.

The hotel environment is calm, neat, and well-maintained. The rooms were very clean, hygienic, and properly sanitized. Regular housekeeping and fresh linens made the stay pleasant. The washrooms were also spotless and well maintained.

In terms of cost, the hotel offers great value for money. The room rates are reasonable compared to the quality of service, cleanliness, and location.

Overall, I am very satisfied with the hygiene, cleanliness, cooperative service, and peaceful environment of this hotel. I would definitely recommend Hotel Kundan Palace to anyone looking for a safe, clean, and affordable stay in New Delhi. I will surely choose this hotel again on my next visit. Special thanks to Bijoy Da and Gopy Da. ❤️
